name: Local Data Models for Probabilistic Transfer Function Design
definition: A technique for interactive multi-dimensional transfer function design that couples high-dimensional, probabilistic, data-centric segmentation with interaction in 3D space. It fits variable Gaussian Mixture Models to user-specified subsets of data to create a probabilistic data model of a material type.
summary: Local Data Models for Probabilistic Transfer Function Design is an interactive method that fits Gaussian Mixture Models to user-selected local data subsets, avoiding the overgeneralization of global statistical models in volume rendering.
